claims.claim: TimeRewarder learns dense proxy rewards from action-free passive videos by predicting frame-wise temporal distances (Figure 2).
claims.evidence: The logbook tested released checkpoints on a fixed five-video-per-task temporal-distance protocol (106 cases across 10 tasks), but explicitly did not reproduce reward-model training; this is a sanity check of a pre-trained artifact on a small fixed video set, not a reproduction of the learning process.
claims.target_claim: TimeRewarder learns dense proxy rewards from action-free passive videos by predicting frame-wise temporal distances (Figure 2).

claims.claim: The method converts predicted progress differences between adjacent frames into step-wise rewards for downstream RL (Section 4.2).
claims.evidence: Three transition-formula cases were checked, verifying the conversion formula in isolation, but the logbook states Meta-World/DrQ-v2 training is unavailable, so the formula was never applied in actual downstream RL.
claims.target_claim: The method converts predicted progress differences between adjacent frames into step-wise rewards for downstream RL (Section 4.2).

claims.claim: The paper provides a theoretical justification connecting temporal distance to progress-based reward shaping (Section 4.3).
claims.evidence: All enumerated finite Bellman recurrences and the gamma-one temporal-distance identity pass under the paper's stated assumptions (full observability, deterministic transitions, optimal trajectory, terminal goal, unaliased observations), providing concrete mathematical verification of the theoretical justification.
claims.target_claim: The paper provides a theoretical justification connecting temporal distance to progress-based reward shaping (Section 4.3).

claims.claim: On held-out expert videos, TimeRewarder reports the highest Value-Order Correlation among evaluated progress-based reward baselines (Figure 3).
claims.evidence: VOC was computed for TimeRewarder's released model (mean 0.998 across 50 videos), but baseline predictions/checkpoints and the complete Figure 3 protocol were not released, making the comparative 'highest among baselines' claim untestable.
claims.target_claim: On held-out expert videos, TimeRewarder reports the highest Value-Order Correlation among evaluated progress-based reward baselines (Figure 3).
